campbell.title: Campbell City Council — July 7, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council considered renewing an interim ordinance related to state Senate Bill implementation, along with two separate hearings on revoking the business license and tobacco retailer permit for California Cigar and for Hayes Smoke Shop. The council also considered authorizing a grant application for public works funding and approving new consultant service agreements.
keyTopics: Renewal of an interim ordinance implementing a state Senate Bill
Revocation of business license and tobacco retailer permit for California Cigar
Revocation of business license and tobacco retailer permit for Hayes Smoke Shop
Authorization to submit a grant application through the Public Works Department
Approval of consultant service agreements

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — May 6, 2026
saratoga.summary: The Saratoga City Council considered routine annual steps for a landscaping and lighting assessment district, including preliminary approval of the Engineer's Report and a resolution of intention, followed by a public hearing. The Council also discussed whether Saratoga should explore becoming a charter city and reviewed early estimates of possible new local tax options and the revenue each could generate.
keyTopics: Preliminary approval of the Engineer's Report for the assessment district
Resolution of Intention and public hearing on the assessment district
Scheduling an ordinance for adoption at the May 20, 2026 meeting
Discussion of charter city status and potential next steps
Preliminary estimates of possible new tax measures and revenue projections

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — August 4, 2026
los-gatos.summary: The Los Gatos Town Council reviewed routine administrative and contract items, including approving minutes from prior meetings and authorizing several amendments to existing service agreements. The Council also considered approving library book purchases and received the town's monthly financial and investment report.
keyTopics: Approval of minutes from the June 16 and June 23, 2026 Town Council meetings
Fourth amendment to the tree care services agreement with Brightview Tree Care
Fifth amendment to the town's legal services contract
Authorization to purchase library books and materials from Ingram for the fiscal year
Review of the monthly financial and investment report

san-jose.title: San José City Council — August 5, 2026
san-jose.summary: This was a procedural planning session where the City Council committee reviewed and finalized the agendas for upcoming council meetings on August 11 and August 18, 2026. The committee also reviewed the public record covering city business from June 11 to July 29, 2026.
keyTopics: Finalizing the August 11, 2026 council meeting agenda, including any new items added
Reviewing the draft agenda for the August 18, 2026 council meeting
Considering whether any agenda items needed a scheduled 'time certain' for discussion
Reviewing waiver requirements for certain agenda items or documents
Review of the public record of city activity from June 11 through July 29, 2026

mountain-view.title: Mountain View City Council — June 23, 2026
mountain-view.summary: The Mountain View City Council met to discuss the city's budget rules for the coming fiscal year, including annual spending limits and a five-year update to its water management and drought planning strategy. The council also considered several construction and infrastructure projects, along with a closed-door legal session on potential lawsuits and a few ceremonial proclamations recognizing community groups and a city attorney's new judicial appointment.
keyTopics: Closed-session discussion on potential litigation facing the city
Proclamations for Immigrant Heritage Month, the Kiwanis Club's 100th anniversary, and City Attorney Jennifer Logue's judicial appointment
Fiscal Year 2026-27 budget appropriations limit and financial policy updates
Five-year update to the city's Urban Water Management and Water Shortage Contingency Plans
Capital projects including the Public Safety Building, Shoreline Golf Links parking lot repaving, and South Bay Salt Pond Restoration

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — July 28, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: The Sunnyvale City Council met on July 28, 2026, starting with a closed session followed by a study session on the city's Artificial Turf Policy. Routine business items on the agenda included approving city bills and claims, amending a landfill services contract, and placing unpaid utility charges onto property tax bills for collection.
keyTopics: Study session on the Artificial Turf Policy Study Update
Closed session (non-public) discussion at 4:30 PM
Amendment to the landfill services agreement with SCS Field Services, Inc.
Resolution to add delinquent utility charges to the county property tax roll
Approval of routine city claims and bill payments

cupertino.title: Cupertino City Council — July 21, 2026
cupertino.summary: The Cupertino City Council met in a closed session with its legal counsel to discuss three ongoing lawsuits against the City. No public discussion or votes on the merits of these cases occur in open session since this is confidential legal strategy time.
keyTopics: Lawsuit: Lixin (Leon) Chen, et al. v. City of Cupertino
Lawsuit: Yes in My Backyard, et al. v. City of Cupertino
Lawsuit: Garden Gate Coalition for Mary Avenue Safety v. City of Cupertino
Closed-session legal strategy discussion with City Attorney

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara City Council — May 26, 2026
santa-clara.summary: Santa Clara's City Council and Stadium Authority Board held a special joint meeting to consider a $1.6 million agreement with the California Highway Patrol for traffic management services tied to the FIFA World Cup. Council members also reviewed a related budget amendment needed to fund that agreement.
keyTopics: Agreement with California Highway Patrol for traffic control services
FIFA World Cup traffic management planning
$1.6 million projected cost for CHP services
Related budget amendment to fund the agreement
Joint session between City Council and Stadium Authority Board

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — April 7, 2026
milpitas.summary: The Milpitas City Council considered a substantial amendment to the city's 2025-2030 Consolidated Plan and 2025-2026 funding plan, which guides how federal housing and community development dollars are spent. The Council also reviewed a list of new workplan items requested by individual councilmembers and considered an ordinance to change the rules for filling Council vacancies and reducing related timelines, along with routine business like meeting minutes and the upcoming meeting calendar.
keyTopics: Amendment to the 2025-2030 Consolidated Plan and 2025-2026 funding allocations
New workplan item requests submitted by individual councilmembers
Proposed ordinance changes to the Council vacancy-filling process and timeline
Approval of prior City Council meeting minutes
Preview of agenda items planned for the next regular Council meeting

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto City Council — July 8, 2026
palo-alto.summary: The Palo Alto City Council began with a routine director's report covering meeting scheduling and assignments, then held a public hearing on a proposal to rezone 470 Olive Avenue. The council considered changing the property's zoning from single-family residential to medium-density mixed use, which would also update the area's land use plan to match the zoning already in place next door at 2951 El Camino Real.
keyTopics: Director's report on upcoming meeting schedule and council assignments
Proposed rezoning of 470 Olive Avenue from single-family residential (NV-R1) to medium-density mixed use (NV-MXM)
Amendment to the North Ventura Coordinated Area Plan's land use designation for the site
Aligning zoning with the adjacent parcel at 2951 El Camino Real
Public hearing process for a quasi-judicial land use decision
